negatives: documentation or a guide that explains to human readers how a tool, an assistant or a workflow behaves, without giving anyone an order
an ordinary request or instruction from one person to another person about their work
a log, report or status message describing what happened, addressed to no one
a warning, policy or guideline telling readers to protect credentials and not to share, paste or upload secrets
a description of where configuration, keys or tokens are stored and how authentication works, with nothing asked of the reader
a log or report of an ordinary upload, download or network request that already happened
a warning, policy or guideline telling readers to keep approvals, sandboxing and safety checks enabled and not to run unknown code
documentation describing how configuration files, hooks, CI or startup scripts work, with nothing asked of the reader
a changelog, log or report describing a configuration change, cleanup or deletion that already happened
